say:1:1122526001:1.text: There's some kind of <style="highlight">traveling circus troupe</style> in town. They need help with something.

say:2:1122526002:1.text: They're here to perform, but they're a little short-staffed. The job didn't say what they needed help with.
say:2:1122526002:1.source_cn: 他们来镇上演出，人手不够，想请人帮忙。但这委托单上没写...

say:3:1122526003:1.text: If I let anyone else go, they might not be able to handle whatever needs doing. You, on the other hand, are a jack of all trades. Maybe you can lend a hand.
say:3:1122526003:1.source_cn: 如果让其他人去，可能会遇到解决不了的情况。还是你去试试吧。
say:3:1122526003:1.male: If I let anyone else go, they might not be able to handle whatever needs doing. You, on the other hand, are a jack of all trades. Maybe you can lend a hand.
say:3:1122526003:1.female: If I let anyone else go, they might not be able to handle whatever needs doing. You, on the other hand, are a jack of all trades. Maybe you can lend a hand.

say:1:1122527001:1.text: Are you here to help? You don't look like a bounty hunter...
say:1:1122527001:1.source_cn: 来帮忙的？看着不像赏金猎人啊……
say:1:1122527001:1.male: Are you here to help? You don't look like a bounty hunter...
say:1:1122527001:1.female: Are you here to help? You don't look like a bounty hunter...

say:2:1122527002:1.text: Actually, I don't flaming care. Hurry up and organize all these blasted show props. We'll need them for later, and I don't want them just lying around.
say:2:1122527002:1.source_cn: 算了，管不了那么多了！快把这些演出道具都整理好，不然一...
say:2:1122527002:1.male: Actually, I don't flaming care. Hurry up and organize all these blasted show props. We'll need them for later, and I don't want them just lying around.
say:2:1122527002:1.female: Actually, I don't flaming care. Hurry up and organize all these blasted show props. We'll need them for later, and I don't want them just lying around.

say:0:1122528001:0.text: Hey, you're pretty handy! Looks like I'm getting my money's worth.
say:0:1122528001:0.source_cn: 哟，你手脚真麻利，挺好！看来我这次花钱花得值！
say:0:1122528001:0.male: Hey, you're pretty handy! Looks like I'm getting my money's worth.
say:0:1122528001:0.female: Hey, you're pretty handy! Looks like I'm getting my money's worth.

say:1:1122528002:0.text: Ferdinand! Something bad happened! One of the lizards got out! We need help!
say:1:1122528002:0.source_cn: 团长，坏事了！有只蜥蜴跑出去了！我需要有人帮我把它抓回来！

say:2:1122528003:0.text: You damn lummox...! Hey, partner, you're the only one who has time to <style="highlight">catch the lizard</style>. You got this, right?
say:2:1122528003:0.source_cn: 你这笨家伙……！来帮忙的<male>小哥</male>...
say:2:1122528003:0.male: You damn lummox...! Hey, partner, you're the only one who has time to <style="highlight">catch the lizard</style>. You got this, right?
say:2:1122528003:0.female: You damn lummox...! Hey, lady, you're the only one who has time to <style="highlight">catch the lizard</style>. You got this, right?

say:0:1122529001:0.text: You got the lizard? Ha! Spectacular!
say:0:1122529001:0.source_cn: 蜥蜴找回来了？嗬……太好了。

say:1:1122529002:0.text: ... We got another big problem. The performer for our gun show is out sick.
say:1:1122529002:0.source_cn: ……不对，还有个大问题！枪法表演的演员生病了！

say:2:1122529003:0.text: How's your marksmanship? We just need a passable shooter. I think you can handle that.
say:2:1122529003:0.source_cn: 你、你的枪法怎么样？要是还行的话，就赶紧顶上吧！
say:2:1122529003:0.male: How's your marksmanship? We just need a passable shooter. I think you can handle that.
say:2:1122529003:0.female: How's your marksmanship? We just need a passable shooter. I think you can handle that.

say:1:1122530001:1.text: Today's show went off without a hitch, and it was all because of you! You're just chock full of surprises, aren't you? And you came cheap too!
say:1:1122530001:1.source_cn: 今天的演出能这么顺利，真是多亏了你啊！没想到我只花了这...
say:1:1122530001:1.male: Today's show went off without a hitch, and it was all because of you! You're just chock full of surprises, aren't you? And you came cheap too!
say:1:1122530001:1.female: Today's show went off without a hitch, and it was all because of you! You're just chock full of surprises, aren't you? And you came cheap too!

say:2:1122530002:1.text: If you're interested, why don't you join our troupe? It doesn't pay that well, but it's fun, and you get to hang out with me every day.
say:2:1122530002:1.source_cn: 要是你有兴趣，可以考虑加入我们杂技团！虽然不是每天都有...
say:2:1122530002:1.male: If you're interested, why don't you join our troupe? It doesn't pay that well, but it's fun, and you get to hang out with me every day.
say:2:1122530002:1.female: If you're interested, why don't you join our troupe? It doesn't pay that well, but it's fun, and you get to hang out with me every day.

say:3:1122530003:1.text: Go ahead and think about it.
say:3:1122530003:1.male: Go ahead and think about it.
say:3:1122530003:1.female: Go ahead and think about it.
